name: ladder-monorepo
description: A calm, levelled language course engine (ladder-core) and its courses.

scripts.content:check: npm run content:check -w english-ladder && npm run content:check -w arabic-ladder && npm run content:check -w mandarin-ladder && npm run content:check -w japanese-ladder && npm run content:check -w spanish-ladder
scripts.test: npm run test -w english-ladder && npm run test -w arabic-ladder && npm run test -w mandarin-ladder && npm run test -w japanese-ladder && npm run test -w spanish-ladder
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w english-ladder && npm run test:e2e -w arabic-ladder && npm run test:e2e -w mandarin-ladder && npm run test:e2e -w japanese-ladder && npm run test:e2e -w spanish-ladder
scripts.test:parity: node tests/parity/verify.mjs english && node tests/parity/verify.mjs arabic && node tests/parity/verify.mjs mandarin && node tests/parity/verify.mjs japanese
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w english-ladder && npm run lint -w arabic-ladder && npm run lint -w mandarin-ladder && npm run lint -w japanese-ladder && npm run lint -w spanish-ladder
